name: maildoc
description: The MailDoc — the doctor for your domain's email

scripts.test: pnpm run check:brands && pnpm run check:tokens && turbo run test
scripts.ship: turbo run build && pnpm run check:brands && pnpm run check:tokens && turbo run test && pnpm --filter @maildoc/web exec wrangler deploy
scripts.domains: pnpm --filter @maildoc/web exec wrangler tail --format json --method GET | jq -r --unbuffered 'select(.event.request.url | test("/api/check")) | [(.eventTimestamp/1000 | todate), (.event.request.url | capture("domain=(?<d>[^&]*)").d)] | @tsv'
